defect.locator_note: lake treatment.derivation.lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited; content_page Treatment & subsequent history
defect.problem: The page asserts a clean good-law treatment call as of 2026-06-30, but the disclosed treatment record does not verify that call to adversarial certainty: the treatment is migration-seeded, the scope note says S2 may downgrade it, and the derivation records audit-needed proposed negative events with cap hits.
defect.proposed_fix: Do not state an unqualified good/no-negative treatment call as of 2026-06-30. Use an audit-pending treatment label, or qualify it as no confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record pending R15 treatment audit.

reasons: The lake field_i_validity is good_law, but provenance shows treatment.field_i_validity came from migration/frontmatter rather than a completed current-treatment audit.
The disclosed derivation records audit_needed true in lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited, cap_hit true in both, and proposed_negative_events of 13 and 25.

The disclosed edges are all proposed and field_iii is mentioned, so they do not prove an overruling from the disclosed record; they do prevent verifying the page's categorical no-negative/current-good-law statement.
residual_risks: Full text or completed audit of the proposed progeny edges is needed to determine whether any edge actually limits Johns.
Because the negative-search lanes hit caps, the disclosed treatment search is bounded rather than exhaustive.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Replace categorical good/no-negative wording with an audit-pending treatment statement until the R15 audit resolves the proposed negative events.
